decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with efficient and aggressive creatures like Guide of Souls, Ocelot Pride, and Amped Raptor. It also includes powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to further pressure opponents. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Containment Priest and Swords to Plowshares while disrupting opponents with cards like Static Prison and Deafening Silence. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive game plan with efficient lands like Wasteland and Karakas.

The deck is focused on aggressive Boros creatures and synergies, aiming to overwhelm the opponent with early pressure and efficient removal. Cards like Guide of Souls and Ocelot Pride provide strong creature support, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory offer additional power and buffs. Containment Priest helps against graveyard strategies, while Galvanic Discharge and Swords to Plowshares provide removal options. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Static Prison and Invasion of Gobakhan to control the board. The manabase is streamlined with fetchlands and utility lands to ensure consistent casting of spells.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly pressure opponents while disrupting their game plan with cards like Daze and Wasteland. It also includes efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Force of Will to control the board and protect its threats. The deck aims to maintain tempo and pressure throughout the game, using cards like Mishra's Bauble and Brainstorm to filter through the deck and find the right answers. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and relentless in its attacks, overwhelming opponents before they can stabilize.

The deck aims to quickly combo off by using the combination of Nomads en-Kor, Cephalid Illusionist, and Shuko to mill the library, activate Narcomoeba and Dread Return, and win the game with a Thassa's Oracle or Nadu, Winged Wisdom. The deck includes various ways to protect the combo with cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, as well as ways to find key pieces with Brainstorm and Ponder. It utilizes powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Cavern of Souls to further support the combo strategy and ensure victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and targeted discard spells while quickly applying pressure with efficient creatures like Brazen Borrower and Nethergoyf. The key strategy is to control the game tempo by efficiently removing threats and disrupting the opponent's hand while deploying threats of your own to close out the game quickly. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The goal is to apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's plays to maintain control of the game and secure a victory.

The main idea of this deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategy while quickly deploying threats and controlling the game tempo. By efficiently removing threats with cards like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, disrupting their hand with Thoughtseize and countering their spells with Daze and Force of Will, you can maintain board control. Additionally, you can quickly generate card advantage with cards like Ponder and Brainstorm, while efficiently deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf to put pressure on your opponent. This deck aims to control the game tempo and outpace your opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying pressure through efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By combining cheap removal, hand disruption, counterspells, and card selection, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and keep the opponent on the back foot. The deck emphasizes being proactive rather than reactive, utilizing the Dimir color combination's strengths in disrupting the opponent's resources and applying pressure quickly. The deck seeks to maintain control of the game through a mix of control elements and aggressive threats.

The deck focuses on using the combo card Doomsday to manipulate the top of the library to win the game with Thassa's Oracle or other win conditions. It includes cards like Street Wraith and Edge of Autumn to set up the Doomsday pile quickly, and protection cards like Force of Will and Daze to ensure the combo goes off without a hitch. The deck also includes filtering and card draw with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Thoughtseize, as well as acceleration with Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual. The goal is to assemble the combo as quickly as possible while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up and disrupt opponents by utilizing cards like Magus of the Moon, Blood Moon, and Chalice of the Void. The deck aims to lock out the opponent's mana base while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck leans heavily on playing efficient threats and disruption spells, with a focus on disrupting the opponent's game plan and quickly closing out the game.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base and prevent them from casting their spells by using cards like Magus of the Moon, Blood Moon, and Chalice of the Void. Additionally, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures like Laelia, the Blade Reforged and Pyrogoyf. The deck also includes removal spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption to deal with threats on the opponent's side of the board. The combination of disruptive elements and aggressive creatures allows the deck to control the game and secure a win.

The main concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to apply pressure on the opponent quickly with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, while disrupting their game plan with disruptive spells like Force of Will, Daze, and Stifle. The deck also includes card draw/filtering options like Brainstorm and Ponder to maintain card quality and find the necessary cards to close out the game. Additionally, it utilizes a land destruction package with cards like Wasteland to slow down opponents and give the deck an advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements such as Swords to Plowshares and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also utilizing the synergy between cards like Knight of the Reliquary, Elvish Reclaimer, and Crop Rotation to establish a strong board presence. The inclusion of Life from the Loam allows for consistent land recursion and synergy with cards like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage, providing an alternate win condition. The deck aims to control the game through disruption and resource management, while also presenting a threatening board state with powerful land combinations.

The deck focuses on using a combination of creatures and lands to quickly apply pressure to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Knight of the Reliquary, Wight of the Reliquary, and Elvish Reclaimer to search for powerful lands such as Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage, the deck aims to create a fast win condition. With cards like Swords to Plowshares for removal and Mox Diamond for ramp, the deck is able to maintain tempo and outpace the opponent. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and powerful land combos.

This deck utilizes the powerful combo potential of Mystic Forge to generate a ton of mana using cards like Grim Monolith, Lotus Petal, and Basalt Monolith. By combining this mana generation with cards like Voltaic Key and Manifold Key, the deck is able to cast powerful spells like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms at a rapid pace. The inclusion of Disruptor Flute and Kozilek's Command provide additional utility and disruption to control the game while ultimately leading to a victory through overwhelming board presence and powerful spells.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the Nomads en-Kor and Nadu, Winged Wisdom combo to generate infinite mana, draw cards, and control the board. Using cards like Murktide Regent, Tamiyo, and Voice of Victory, the deck aims to create a powerful synergy between creatures and spells to overwhelm the opponent. With a mix of counterspells, removal, and card selection tools like Brainstorm and Ponder, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition. Overall, the deck focuses on comboing off while maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Nomads en-Kor and Nadu, Winged Wisdom to create an infinite combo loop that allows for massive card draw and mana generation. This combo is supported by Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Voice of Victory to control the board and protect the combo pieces. The deck includes various disruption spells such as Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect the combo. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Murktide Regent and Urza's Saga for additional win conditions and card advantage. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with card advantage and powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on using low-cost creatures like Ornithopter and Baleful Strix to quickly put pressure on the opponent while utilizing ninjutsu abilities from creatures like Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow and Ingenious Infiltrator to trigger powerful effects. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Brazen Borrower and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand, while also using control spells like Fatal Push and Force of Will to maintain board presence. The inclusion of Retrofitter Foundry provides additional versatility in generating creatures and the ability to adapt to different game situations.

The deck focuses on quickly getting out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield using cards like Show and Tell and Omniscience. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with these high-impact creatures and powerful spells, while also having tools like Force of Will and Veil of Summer to protect the combo. The deck also includes ways to dig for key cards with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Cunning Wish, providing consistency in setting up the combo.

The deck revolves around assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's entire library in a single turn. It also utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Goblin Welder to support the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck includes versatile spells like Pyroblast and Lightning Bolt for removal and disruption, along with artifacts like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal for ramp. Overall, the key strategy is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and control the game to achieve a decisive victory.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures, then bringing them back to the battlefield using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. By combining efficient discard spells like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize with fast mana like Lotus Petal, the deck aims to cheat out massive threats like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty early in the game. The inclusion of Worldgorger Dragon allows for infinite combos with Dance of the Dead, providing a powerful win condition. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its graveyard-based reanimation strategy.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly generate mana with cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Petal, play multiple spells in a turn to build storm count, and then use cards like Infernal Tutor and Burning Wish to search for win conditions like Tendrils of Agony. The deck focuses on using efficient combo pieces like Dark Ritual and Cabal Ritual to generate the necessary mana to win the game in one explosive turn. The deck also includes disruption elements like Duress and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand and prevent them from interfering with the combo.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back into play using Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck utilizes cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize to set up the graveyard while also running counterspells like Force of Will to protect its combo pieces. The deck has a mix of evasive creatures like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent along with game-changing creatures like Archon of Cruelty. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and hand disruption.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then bringing them back to the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The key strategy is to reanimate powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty or Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces and ensure a successful reanimation. It aims to win the game through powerful, fast-paced combo plays.

This deck focuses on using efficient spells and creatures to control the board and pressure the opponent quickly. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counter spells like Force of Will and Daze, while deploying threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent to close out the game. By combining tempo plays with aggressive creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own strategy. The deck's mana base and card selection tools help maintain consistency and adaptability in a fast-paced Legacy environment.

This deck aims to put pressure on the opponent quickly with efficient creatures and burn spells, while also disrupting their game plan with countermagic and land destruction. The key strategy is to tempo the opponent by deploying threats early, protecting them with counter spells, and disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Wasteland and Price of Progress. The deck's goal is to maintain a strong board presence while preventing the opponent from stabilizing or mounting a comeback.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while dealing consistent damage. It utilizes a combination of cheap countermagic, efficient removal spells, and powerful creatures to apply pressure and maintain tempo. The deck aims to outpace the opponent and force them to react to its threats, while also utilizing card draw and card selection tools to ensure consistency and adaptability. The mana base is optimized for fast and reliable color access to support the aggressive gameplay.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence with aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to maintain tempo by utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ponder to dig for threats and answers. The inclusion of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provides additional reach to close out games quickly. The mana base is optimized for consistency and resource denial with cards like Wasteland.
